name: Exclude Left School Students from Marks and Results
releaseNote: Students with status Left School are excluded from Marks Entry, result analysis averages, class ranking, standard result registers, and bulk result print. Existing marks and student records are retained; no Supabase schema change.
notes: Grade-only marks remain excluded from total, percentage, pass/fail, and class rank. No student data, marks, exam records, or Supabase schema changed.
